title: Check if Word Can Be Placed In Crossword
summary: Given an m x n matrix board representing a crossword puzzle with lowercase letters, spaces, and blocked cells, determine if a word can be placed horizontally or vertically without violating placement rules.
statement: Given an m x n matrix board representing a crossword puzzle with lowercase letters, spaces, and blocked cells, determine if a word can be placed horizontally or vertically without violating placement rules. The word cannot occupy a '#' cell, must fit in ' ' cells, and must not have adjacent lowercase letters or spaces on either side if placed horizontally or vertically.
constraints: board is a nonempty matrix of lowercase letters, spaces, and # blocks.
The word may run horizontally or vertically in either direction; spaces accept any letter and existing letters must match.
The cells immediately before and after the placement direction must be outside the board or blocked.
hints: A legal placement is an exact bounded slot match in one of four directions.
Try every start and direction, checking the boundary cells and each character-compatible board cell.
Require before/after blocked or outside; require each cell blank or equal to its word character.
The four direction vectors cover both orientations and reversals, while the boundary and cell predicates are exactly the placement rules.
editorial: The four direction vectors cover both orientations and reversals, while the boundary and cell predicates are exactly the placement rules.

tests.explanation: Reading upward through the final column-compatible slot places abc.
The right column exactly matches abc vertically.
